description: Self-hosted PHP appointment scheduling app with providers, customers, services, appointments, and Docker Compose.

notes: The upstream compose file defaults nginx to port 80 and MySQL to 3306.
The app requires dependency installation/build steps inside the app container before full browser-level use.
Best initial target for Connect platform flows where providers onboard and customers pay for bookings.
This fixture is heavier than Hive and Scrumboy; use after the first two external fixtures are stable.
